thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: automatic page for service=embeddings-api (ap-southeast1) — high 5xx rate detected. PagerDuty incident #PD-76821 fired.
pagerduty: PD alert: embeddings-api ap-southeast1 — 502 spike (>= 7% error rate over 2m). Link: https://pd.local/incidents/PD-76821
sasha: @pagerduty got it, I'm oncall. looking at metrics now :eyes:
devon: I see a sharp jump at 03:14 UTC, RTTs also increased. Could be kvcache evictions or a proxy layer.
ali: quick check — rolling deploys in ap-southeast? deploy-bot: No active deploys in that region in last 30m.
sasha: running quick curl against edge gateway: `curl -I https://embeddings.redwood/api/health -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"` -> responses cluster around `502 0.12` and many timeouts.
leah: can someone grab pod logs for embeddings-api in ap-southeast? `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=embeddings-api -o wide`
devon: logs show repeated upstream timeout to model-hosts: `2026-02-18T03:15:04Z ERROR upstream read timeout after 30s` on several pods. Also `kvcache eviction: keyspace exceeded` warnings earlier.
sasha: customer impact: preliminary SLO check -> ~2.1% of requests failing, but a few large customers (cust-alpha, cust-omega) report higher error rates. Escalate to infra if needed.
ali: trying quick mitigation: increasing replica count by 2 and bumping kvcache memory limit on the deployment. doing `kubectl scale deployment/embeddings-api --replicas=8 -n prod` and patching configmap for cache size.
sasha: also shifting some traffic away from ap-southeast to eu-west1 as temporary fallback. runbook suggests adaptive reroute: `service-router set-weight embeddings-api ap-southeast1 0.6 eu-west1 0.4` — applying now.
deploy-bot: service-router: weight update accepted (txn 0x4f2a).
devon: after weight change error rate down to ~3.5% within 90s and 502s per-second trending down.
leah: cache patch applied, restarted 3 pods: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/embeddings-api -n prod`
sasha: good progress. continuing to monitor. notifying CS for impacted customers and asking support to open outreach tickets for cust-alpha and cust-omega.
ali: adding alert suppression for the next 10m to avoid autopager noise while we stabilize. `incident-bot: suppress next 10m for alert=embeddings-502-spike`
pagerduty: PD update: incident acknowledged by sasha. escalation suspended while mitigation in flight.
sasha: next steps: keep traffic partial to eu-west1, watch latency tail and KV eviction rate. If errors persist after 10m, we'll escalate to infra and consider model-host rollback. tagging runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-502-handling
devon: jotting quick postmortem notes: suspected root cause = kvcache memory pressure -> upstream timeouts -> 502 fanout. Will follow up with quantization service owners.
incident-bot: Incident thread closed for now — monitoring only. React with :thumbsup: when you confirm stabilized.
leah: :thumbsup: stabilized on my end, error rate ~0.6% and no new 30s upstream timeouts.
ali: :thumbsup: I'll leave suppression to expire and then re-enable normal alerts.
sasha: thanks team — will draft customer incident email and schedule a short blameless postmortem tomorrow.
